title.narrative: Resilience Informed Urban Planning Support to the Naryn Urban Resilience Programme (NURP)

description.narrative: A Memorandum of Understanding was signed between AKDN/AKTC/UCA and the Naryn Municipality in June 2018 (the MoU). The objective of this MoU was to clarify the terms of cooperation between the various parties regarding the preparation of the Naryn Master Plan, including its territorial components and the spatial aspects of its urban configuration. Under the MoU, AKDN (AKTC) acted as project adviser to the Mayor’s Office and, within the standard planning framework used by the Kyrgyz government for urban planning, steered the development of comprehensive terms of reference, initially for the strategic master plan, and later, for the territorial and urban components of the town’s masterplan. Phase I and II of the Naryn Master Plan have been completed. Following the approval of the Naryn Master Plan, Phase II in December 2021, the Naryn’s government requested AKDN for continued advisory services and support for the Phase III of the master plan which consists in developing a detailed resilience informed planning and implementing a pilot initiative while strengthening institutional capacity and preparing the project for future investment. Hence, the Naryn Urban Resilience Programme comes as a joint initiative for strengthening resilient urban planning and development capacities in Naryn city, Naryn oblast and at the national level as a basis for sustainable economic development. The project supports Naryn to shape its urban development trajectory and align its future investments in a natural hazards and climate-resilient way. Naryn will act as showcase for resilient urban planning and development for other cities in Kyrgyzstan and potentially in the region. The lessons learnt in Naryn will be shared with the national level in the frame of the policy-dialogue on resilience for further replication. Naryn has been selected for this project to act as showcase for resilient urban planning and development, creating a hub of demand based academic activity and economic development with UCA and its design as a "university town" and the implications thereof. Further, this is the pilot area for empowerment and overall improvement to address its poor economic condition, natural hazard profile and updated skill set and performance capacity. This project is fully in line with Kyrgyzstan’s state priorities. The main direct beneficiaries include the key institutions and relevant officials involved at municipal, oblast, and national levels. The project is expected to indirectly benefit the approximately 50,000 residents of Naryn city. The project will be implemented by the Aga Khan Development Network (AKDN) related agencies with strong partnership with national government and non-government agencies, ministries, and organizations. It builds on the experiences of Aga Khan’s Habitat Planning framework, shared methodologies and analysis between AKAH and UN-Habitat through neighbouring urban resilience projects in the region and implementation experiences of Aga Khan Network agencies. AKDN has worked closely with Municipal, Oblast and National planning partners in Kyrgyzstan to provide master planning support to the development of a Town Plan for Naryn. This investment has enabled the Government and partners to understand the opportunities for further development and to put in place guidelines for growth. Within the scope of the Naryn Urban Resilience Initiative, the Consultants (AKTC Consultants and UN-Habitat) will support incorporating critical resilience criteria and will support the inclusion of those into an updated town plan. Within the context of the resilient town plan and the investment plan the following key interventions will be completed: • Supporting the Committee of Architecture and Construction in developing a Resilient Town Plan: The consultant(s) will work with the Committee of Architecture and Construction and with the Committee of Emergency Situations and Civil Defence to incorporate the inputs from the UNDRR/UN-Habitat engagement into a cohesive town plan which will include inputs from the Steering Committee, Advisory Committee and from the communities in Naryn. • UNHABITAT to incorporate UNDRR Criteria into town plan: AKDN globally has signed an MoU with UN-Habitat to collaborate on the development of resilient settlements worldwide and has been working with them in the Khorog Urban Resilience Initiative to ensure that the Town Plan meet the requirements of a resilient city plan. Under the NURP and building on the ongoing planning process developed during Phases I and II of the Naryn Master Plan, the Resilient Urban Planning activities proposed to support the development of the Phase III of the masterplan will be implemented under the following components: 1) Integrating Sustainability and Resilience Principles into Naryn Master Plan; 2) Resilience Informed Urban Planning; 3) Capital Investment Plan; 4) Capacity Development Strategy.
